{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''Barabel settlement''' located on the southern continent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abraxin]] suffered from what the locals believed to be the fabled [[Blight of Barabel]]. The town was populated by members of the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and contained an [[Unidentified eatery|eatery]] that sold [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverages, which included a local [[Abraxin beer|beer]] as well as [[Abraxin Brandy]].<ref name="DarthP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Barabel settlement was mentioned in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="DarthP" />
